a:r.a:t: TPP Is a Common Acetaldehyde Carrier

p:cNvPr.descr: A table lists some TPP-dependent reactions. • Enzyme is pyruvate decarboxylase and pathway is ethanol fermentation. Bond-cleaved pyruvate decarboxylase, where C bonds left to R1, double bonds up to O, bonds right to C (this bond line is pink), which double bonds up and right to O and bonds down and right to O-. Bond formed pyruvate decarboxylate, where C bonds left to R1, double bonds up and right to O, and bonds down and right to H (this bond is pink). • Enzyme is pyruvate dehydrogenase α-Ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and pathways are synthesis of acetyl-CoA and citric acid cycle. Bond cleaved pyruvate dehydrogenase alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, where C bonds left to R2, double bonds up to O, and right to C (this bond line is in pink). C double bonds up and right to O and bonds down and right to O-. Bond cleaved pyruvate dehydrogenase alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase where C bonds left to R2, double bonds up and right to O and down and right to S-CoA (this bond line is pink). • Enzyme is transketolase and the pathways are carbon-assimilation reactions and pentose phosphate pathway. Bond cleaved transketolase where C bonds left to R3, which double bonds up to O, and bonds right to C (this bond line is pink), which bonds up to OH, right to R4, and down to H. Bond formed transketolase where C double bonds up to O, bonds left to R3 and right to C (this bond line is pink), which bonds up to OH, right to R5, and down to H.

p:cNvPr.descr: Image (a) is thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP). It begins on the left with a hexagon with alternating sides. The top point bonds up to NH2. The top left point is N. The bottom left point bonds down and left to H3C. The bottom point is N. The top right point bonds up and right to CH2, which bonds right to a psoitively charged N, which is at the left point of a pentagon. The bottom left point bonds down and left to H3C. The top right point is S, and at the top left point, a red C bonds up to a red H. Above this is a bracket labeled thiazolium ring. The bottom right point bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds right to CH2, which bonds right to O, which bonds right to P. P double bonds up to O, bonds down to O- and right to O, which bonds right to P, which bonds down and right to O- and double bonds up to O. There are numbers inside the pentagon: 1 is at the top right point; 2 is at the top point; and 3 is at the left point. At the bottom left point, on the outside, is 4, and on the outside of the bottom right side is 5.

p:cNvPr.descr: Image (b) is hydroxyethyl thiamine pyrophosphate. It is the same as TPP, but the top point of the pentagon is C, which bonds up to C, which bonds left to H3C, up to H, and right to OH (all in pink). This has a bracket to the right labeled active acetaldehyde. There are also no numbers in this image.
